_metadata.title: ComplianceLint Interim Standard for EU AI Act Article 53: Obligations for Providers of GPAI Models
_metadata.disclaimer: This is an interim checklist developed by ComplianceLint. It is not a harmonised standard and does not itself give a presumption of conformity. Article 40(2) provides for standardisation requests covering, as applicable, the obligations in Chapter V, Sections 2 and 3; no harmonised standard for Article 53 has been published. Until a harmonised standard is published, Article 53(4) permits providers to rely on codes of practice within the meaning of Article 56. The General-Purpose AI Code of Practice was published on 10 July 2025 and assessed as an adequate voluntary tool by the Commission and the Board on 1 August 2025. The Commission has also published guidelines on the obligations of providers of general-purpose AI models and the template for the summary of training content.
basis: EU AI Act Annex XI (Technical Documentation for GPAI models)
EU AI Act Annex XII (Information for downstream providers)
EU AI Office Code of Practice for GPAI providers

requirements.title: Technical Documentation (Annex XI)
requirements.requirement: Except where Article 53(2) applies, a GPAI-model provider MUST draw up and keep current technical documentation of its model, including at least the applicable Annex XI information (Article 53(1)(a)).
requirements.rationale: Art. 53(1)(a) requires technical documentation of the model containing, at a minimum, the information set out in Annex XI. Under Art. 53(2) this does not apply to providers of models released under a free and open-source licence that allows for the access, usage, modification, and distribution of the model, and whose parameters, including the weights, the information on the model architecture, and the information on model usage, are made publicly available, unless the model is a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk.
acceptable_implementations: Comprehensive model card covering all Annex XI elements
Technical documentation repository with version control
Structured documentation system aligned with Annex XI checklist

requirements.title: Downstream Provider Documentation (Annex XII)
requirements.requirement: Except where Article 53(2) applies, a GPAI-model provider MUST draw up, keep current and make available to downstream AI-system providers the integration information and documentation required by Article 53(1)(b) and Annex XII.
requirements.rationale: Art. 53(1)(b) requires information and documentation that enable providers of AI systems who intend to integrate the model to have a good understanding of its capabilities and limitations and to comply with their own obligations under the Regulation, containing at a minimum the elements set out in Annex XII. The free and open-source exception of Art. 53(2) applies here too, except for general-purpose AI models with systemic risk.
acceptable_implementations: Downstream integration guide covering all Annex XII elements
API documentation with capability descriptions and limitations
Structured information package for downstream compliance

requirements.title: Copyright Policy and Compliance
requirements.requirement: The provider MUST put in place a policy to comply with Union copyright law, including identification and compliance with text and data mining opt-out reservations.
requirements.rationale: Art. 53(1)(c) mandates a copyright compliance policy, particularly regarding TDM opt-outs under the DSM Directive.
acceptable_implementations: Published copyright policy with TDM opt-out compliance process
Automated robots.txt and opt-out reservation crawler
Copyright compliance framework with training data provenance tracking

requirements.title: Training Data Summary
requirements.requirement: The provider MUST draw up and make publicly available a sufficiently detailed summary of the content used for training the GPAI model.
requirements.rationale: Art. 53(1)(d) requires a public training data summary to enable copyright holders to exercise their rights.
acceptable_implementations: Published training data summary following the EU AI Office template
Public data card with dataset descriptions and sources
Transparency report covering training data composition and provenance

scoring.partial: R01 + R02 met, R03 or R04 incomplete
